title: Relative Clauses and Complex Sentences

content.content:
## Relativsetningar -- bygg komplekse setningar

For å skrive godt engelsk i 9. klasse treng du meir enn korte, enkle setningar. Du treng å kunne byggje **komplekse setningar** (*complex sentences*) som inneheld meir informasjon.

Ei **relativsetning** (*relative clause*) er ei leddsetning som gir ekstra informasjon om eit substantiv. Ho startar med eit **relativpronomen** (*relative pronoun*):

- **who** -- om personar
- **which** -- om ting og dyr
- **that** -- om personar og ting (meir uformelt)
- **whose** -- eigarskap
- **where** -- om stader
- **when** -- om tid

content.title: Defining vs. Non-defining Relative Clauses
content.content:
**Defining relative clause** (bestemmande relativsetning):
- Gir nødvendig informasjon -- utan ho veit vi ikkje kven/kva vi snakkar om
- INGEN komma
- Kan bruke "that"
- "The student **who won the prize** is from my class."
- "The book **that I read last week** was amazing."

**Non-defining relative clause** (ikkje-bestemmande relativsetning):
- Gir ekstra informasjon som ikkje er nødvendig for å forstå setninga
- MED komma
- Kan IKKJE bruke "that"
- "My sister, **who lives in London**, is a doctor."
- "The Eiffel Tower, **which was built in 1889**, is in Paris."

**Test:** Fjern relativsetninga. Gir setninga framleis meining?
- JA → non-defining (med komma)
- NEI → defining (utan komma)

content.title: Eksempel: Defining vs. non-defining
content.problem:
Kva er skilnaden mellom desse to setningane?

1. "My brother who lives in Bergen is a teacher."
2. "My brother, who lives in Bergen, is a teacher."
content.solution:
**Setning 1 (defining -- utan komma):**
- Impliserer at du har fleire brør
- Relativsetninga spesifiserer *kva* bror: den som bur i Bergen
- Utan relativsetninga veit vi ikkje kven vi snakkar om

**Setning 2 (non-defining -- med komma):**
- Du har berre éin bror
- "who lives in Bergen" er tilleggsinformasjon
- Utan relativsetninga gir setninga framleis meining: "My brother is a teacher."

**Konklusjon:** Kommaa gjer ein faktisk skilnad for tydinga!

exercise.task: Fyll inn med rett relativpronomen: who, which, that, whose, where eller when.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: The woman _____ lives next door is a doctor.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: The film _____ we watched was really boring.

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: This is the park _____ we used to play as children.

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: The boy _____ father is a pilot wants to be an astronaut.

subTasks.label: e
subTasks.task: Summer is the season _____ most Norwegians go on holiday.

exercise.solution: a) who, b) that/which, c) where, d) whose, e) when. Hugs: who = person, which/that = ting, where = stad, whose = eigarskap, when = tid.

exercise.task: Set saman to setningar til éi ved hjelp av ei relativsetning.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: "J.K. Rowling is a famous author. She wrote Harry Potter."
subTasks.solution: J.K. Rowling, who wrote Harry Potter, is a famous author. (Non-defining -- vi veit kven Rowling er)

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: "I met a girl. Her mother works at our school."
subTasks.solution: I met a girl whose mother works at our school. (Defining -- 'whose' viser eigarskap)

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: "That is the restaurant. We had dinner there last Friday."
subTasks.solution: That is the restaurant where we had dinner last Friday. (Defining -- spesifiserer kva restaurant)

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: "The phone is expensive. I want to buy it."
subTasks.solution: The phone that/which I want to buy is expensive. (Defining -- spesifiserer kva telefon)

hints: Sjå om relativsetninga er nødvendig (defining) eller tilleggsinformasjon (non-defining)
exercise.solution: Relativsetningar gjer det mogleg å kombinere informasjon i éi setning i staden for to korte.

content.content:
## Andre typar leddsetningar for komplekse setningar

I tillegg til relativsetningar finst andre typar leddsetningar som gjer skrivinga di meir avansert:

**Tidssetningar (time clauses):**
- "**When** I arrived, the party had already started."
- "**Before** you leave, please close the window."
- "**After** she graduated, she moved to Oslo."
- "**While** I was studying, my phone rang."

**Årsakssetningar (reason clauses):**
- "She stayed home **because** she was ill."
- "**Since** you asked, I'll tell you the truth."
- "**As** it was raining, we took the bus."

**Føremålssetningar (purpose clauses):**
- "I studied hard **so that** I could pass the exam."
- "She whispered **in order not to** wake the baby."

**Innrømmingssetningar (concession clauses):**
- "**Although** it was cold, we went swimming."
- "**Even though** she was tired, she kept working."
- "**Despite** the rain, we had a great time."

exercise.task: Forbind setningane med konjunksjonen i parentes.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task: She was tired. She continued working. (although)
subTasks.solution: Although she was tired, she continued working.

subTasks.label: b
subTasks.task: I will call you. I arrive at the airport. (when)
subTasks.solution: I will call you when I arrive at the airport. (Merk: present simple i when-setninga, ikkje will)

subTasks.label: c
subTasks.task: He missed the bus. He woke up late. (because)
subTasks.solution: He missed the bus because he woke up late.

subTasks.label: d
subTasks.task: She studied hard. She wanted to get good grades. (so that)
subTasks.solution: She studied hard so that she could get good grades.

hints: Hugs: Etter 'when', 'before', 'after' i framtid bruker vi present simple, IKKJE will
Legg komma etter leddsetninga når ho kjem først
exercise.solution: a) Although she was tired, she continued working. b) I will call you when I arrive. c) He missed the bus because he woke up late. d) She studied hard so that she could get good grades.

exercise.task: Skriveoppgåve: Forbetre ein tekst med relativsetningar og leddsetningar.

subTasks.label: a
subTasks.task:
Her er ein tekst med berre korte, enkle setningar. Skriv han om slik at han inneheld minst 3 relativsetningar og 2 andre leddsetningar:

"I have a friend. She is from England. She moved to Norway last year. She likes skiing. She had never tried it before. She learned quickly. She practices every weekend. She wants to compete next winter."
subTasks.solution: Eksempel: 'I have a friend who is from England. She moved to Norway last year, where she discovered skiing. Although she had never tried it before, she learned quickly because she is very sporty. She practices every weekend so that she can compete next winter, which is her big dream.'

hints: Bruk who, which, where for relativsetningar
Bruk although, because, when, so that for andre leddsetningar
exercise.solution: Å kombinere korte setningar til lengre, meir komplekse setningar gjer teksten din meir moden og lettlesen.

content.content:
## Oppsummering

**Relativpronomen:**
- who (person), which (ting), that (begge), whose (eigarskap), where (stad), when (tid)

**Defining vs. non-defining:**
- Defining: nødvendig info, ingen komma: "The girl who called is my friend."
- Non-defining: tilleggsinfo, med komma: "Maria, who called earlier, is my friend."

**Andre leddsetningar:**
- Tid: when, before, after, while
- Årsak: because, since, as
- Føremål: so that, in order to
- Innrømming: although, even though, despite

**Tips for betre skriving:**
- Varier setningslengda: nokre korte, nokre lange
- Bruk leddsetningar for å vise samanhengar (årsak, tid, kontrast)
- Unngå å skrive berre korte, enkle setningar -- det verkar umode
- Unngå også å skrive berre lange setningar -- det blir tungt å lese
